checks: Native confirmed workspace reset restores default autosave1000 after restart-persisted zero;documents and sessions remain mounted.
Two same-resource session identities and both visible views restore after process restart from a persisted metadata receipt.
M15 workspace autosave0 survives process restart;Ctrl+Alt+PageDown/PageUp focuses distinct same-resource views;closing one retains one editor;typed collection pin navigates as collection.
Native WebView pointer grips reorder duplicate session IDs;Escape cancels a subsequent drag;no empty native import dialog.
Native code language popup opens, traverses and returns focus on Escape;code copy uses Rust clipboard receipt;existing Tiptap table insertion renders. Advanced table/CSV behavior is not certified.
limitations: No OS cache flush; first-profile startup is not true cold boot.
Input-to-rAF is a responsiveness proxy, not physical input-to-presentation.
Process working sets sum shared pages; sampled peak can miss short spikes.
M6 uses an isolated WebView2 profile to coexist with a running personal app; first-profile webview caches differ from M1–M5 shared-profile runs.

Only the disposable application process tree is sampled; background apps, power and cache conditions are uncontrolled. The M8 reference had a coexisting personal process; inspect coexistingPersonalReference for this run.

M15 scripted motion samples capture computed geometry and animation state;physical visual judgement is recorded separately. Full three-pane, advanced table/image/CSV and Explorer drag-out remain excluded.
